format: Five 2×2 atlases. Top row SR fine illustration; bottom row SSR gilded relief and enamel. Existing four illustration atlases now supply R cards.

prompts.everyday-premium:
Create ONE final production artwork atlas for a premium collectible card collection. Exactly TWO columns and TWO rows, four equally sized independent portrait panels, flush edges, no gaps or gutters, total canvas aspect ratio 8:11. The four panels must NOT flow into each other. No letters, words, numbers, rarity labels, logos, or watermarks. Each panel is an actual card illustration filling its entire quadrant, not cards photographed on a table. Keep important figures within central 80%, reserve lower 12% calmer for the app's title overlay.
CRITICAL MATERIAL HIERARCHY: TOP ROW = SR. Exquisite fine-lined cinematic illustration, translucent layered watercolor and cel shading, intricate environment, strongly directed silver/pearl rim lighting, beautifully drawn character or creature, focused storytelling, fine selective silver accents, matte paper base. BOTTOM ROW = SSR. Radically higher tactile luxury: elaborate raised gilt metal bas-relief and cloisonné enamel, gemstone-like translucent color, sculpted embossed figure/creature standing proud of the substrate, deep architectural multi-plane composition, prismatic foil reflections, dramatic volumetric light. Must visibly look three-dimensional, polished, luminous, and collectible at thumbnail scale, unlike flat painted SR. Not merely a gold border around identical art. Restrained thin filigree corner elements integrated in bottom panels only, do not consume central illustration. A premium art museum jewel meets fantastical trading card, meticulous craftsmanship. Both bottom panels should have large powerful silhouettes, rich but controlled contrasts and extraordinary depth. NO flat gouache for the SSR row. Series EVERYDAY LIGHT: ordinary life becoming extraordinary. Top left: rainy midnight café window, a quiet student with journal, suspended raindrops, warm amber lamplight contrasting slate-blue city, beautifully detailed cinematic illustration. Top right: sunlit rooftop greenhouse tended by a young botanist, emerald leaves, pearl glass, tiny birds, lavish watercolor light and delicate silver accents. Bottom left: an ordinary desk opening into an immense radiant gilded library-universe, luminous enamel books and staircases spiraling around a brilliant crystal sun, diminutive reader for monumental scale, gold/ivory/sapphire sculpted relief. Bottom right: a small glowing apartment window unfurling into an enormous rose-gold tree of light over a deep emerald city, layered raised branches, opal blossoms, starry polished metal sky, every branch tactile and jewel-like.
